name: Our Lady of Perpetual Succour, Blackburn

boundary.description: From the junction of Roman Road and Stopes Brow, W by Stopes Brow, Rakes Bridge, Fore Street to River Darwen. Then N by River Darwen, to Bolton Road, and N along Bolton Road, then S E (after bent) by Longshaw Lane, Pritchard Street, Lyndhurst Road, Park Lee Road, and S by Roman Road to its junction with Stopes Brow.
